UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_BRANCHCODES] SET BRANCH_NAME='TEST BR' 
WHERE BRANCHID='1313' AND H = 'D';


DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_BRANCHCODES]
WHERE BRANCHID='1440' AND H = 'D';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_BRANCHCODES] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20240705','20240708');


INSERT INTO [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_BRANCHCODES]
(
	  H
	,[BANK_CODE]
	,[SOURCE_SYSTEM]
	,[BRANCHID]
	,[BRANCH_NAME]
	,[AREA_CODE]
	,[REGION_CODE]
	,[REGION]
	,[TAGGING]
	,[FILE_NAME]
	,[insert_dttm]
)
SELECT 
	'D' H
	,[BANK_CODE]
	,[SOURCE_SYSTEM]
	,'9999' [BRANCHID]
	,[BRANCH_NAME]
	,[AREA_CODE]
	,[REGION_CODE]
	,[REGION]
	,[TAGGING]
	,[FILE_NAME]
	,[insert_dttm]
FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CCD_BRANCHCODES]  WHERE BRANCHID='1313' AND H = 'D';
